DESCRIPTION: The URL of the HashiCorp Vault server, e.g. https://vault.example.com:8200. No default: without an address the Vault storage stays inactive.
The path to the KV secret engine.
The version of the KV secret engine (e.g., 1 or 2).
The Vault role to use for Kubernetes authentication. If not set, the application name is used.
The mount path for the Kubernetes auth method in Vault.

Path of the ServiceAccount token file sent to Vault. Recommended: a projected token with a Vault audience. If not set: KUBERNETES_SA_TOKEN_PATH if set, else /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token.
Allow Kubernetes login over plain http, and let VAULT_SSL_VERIFY disable TLS verification. For development and tests only.
Static Vault token to use if Kubernetes auth is not available. If not set, the VAULT_TOKEN environment variable is used.
Polling interval in milliseconds to check for secret updates. Set to 0 to disable polling.
